title: Software Engineer II · Forward Deployed Delivery, Solutions & Product
highlights: Delivered about 10 end-to-end industrial software implementations across pharma, food, campus utilities, biofuels, and chemicals for sites of 30–150 users. Owned discovery, design, configuration, integrations, UAT, go-live, training, and hypercare, including 4–5 concurrent projects at peak, with two priority enterprise rollouts finished on deadline.

Led discovery with executives, client IT, vendors, plant managers, and lead operators. Turned operational workflows into process maps, solution architectures, Jira user stories, acceptance criteria, and phased rollouts. Delivered 30–40 tailored technical demos a year and supported expansion scoping. 8 of 10 customers returned for a second phase or extra work.

Led client-side use-case design and testing for the first Shiftconnector (Seqonis) to SAP PM integration, covering asset, material, maintenance-notification, and work-order data in operator workflows, and helped turn the first build into a reusable offering. Another engineer led the primary coding. Also connected Augmentir and GoCanvas to SAP/ERP, CMMS, historians, alarms/events, and equipment logs through REST/JSON APIs, validated in Postman and acceptance testing.

Wrote the core execution code for a one-click testing product at a Fortune 500 food manufacturer: about 50 tests across 11 functions connecting Augmentir, a central data fabric, and SAP/ERP. Coordinated dashboard, report, and email pieces with other engineers. The framework is used at several sites in the United States and Mexico.

Mapped source fields to destination fields, cleaned functional-location and asset data before import, and migrated historical data between historians. Built Python and PowerShell deployment automation, including bulk configuration, validation, and logging, cutting manual setup effort by up to 60%.

Built TypeScript/JavaScript and Python workflow functions for routing, validation, and UI behavior, with 20–55 unit tests per function. Built LLM-powered operator assistants with structured knowledge, prompt templates, and response guardrails, and an internal OCR document-extraction proof of concept. Escalated field feedback that became a vendor platform feature. Point person for the Shiftconnector (Seqonis) product line.

Owned post-go-live support across SaaS, on-prem, and hybrid deployments: SSO/Active Directory, API, workflow, reporting, and data issues, documented in runbooks. Trained key users and administrators, including day and night shifts, in person and remote.

title: Enterprise Apps Project Management Intern
